objects.description: [CanisterWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9042) has performed environment fingerprinting to identify Kubernetes clusters.(Citation: Palo Alto TeamPCP MAR 2026) [CanisterWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9042) has also searched for Kubernetes pods using the command ` os.path.exists("/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount") or "KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST" in os.environ `.(Citation: Aikido CanisterWorm MAR 2026)
